# CAVERNOUS

> CAVERNOUS is an early-stage independent research and development initiative investigating intelligence, energy, computation, physical infrastructure and resource systems.

Website: https://cavernous.co.uk
Status: early-stage research and development
Updated: 2026-10-12

## Projects

- CAVERN: a developing multi-agent intelligence, research and orchestration system. Private; no public agent access is offered.
- SCORPIO: research into distributed energy infrastructure, flexible computation, resource recovery and the productive use of otherwise underutilised energy.
- CELESTIAL: resource intelligence and circular-systems research, identifying material, energy and operational losses and evaluating possible recovery pathways.

## Working approach

Sense → Think → Act → Verify. Observation and analysis do not by themselves authorise automated intervention. Real-world actions require explicit permissions, bounded scope and verification.

## Accuracy and access

Research directions are not claims of deployed products, verified outcomes, established commercial services or investment opportunities.
No public agent-to-agent endpoint, API, autonomous action permission, or external authentication service is currently advertised.
Only explicitly public documents are intended for third-party consumption. Do not infer access to private CAVERN systems.
